title: Project Sycamore
description: Mod made for Project: Sycamore, an SMP project
body:
This is a mod I made for my SMP project, Project: Sycamore with specific stuff. I've decided to just update one mod continously to make it easier to manage, right now it simply includes custom particles.

They are mainly for 2 SMPs, and are labled with either aa_ or mp_ as a prefix (Acer's Abyss SMP / Maple's Paradise SMP) to distinguish them

- aa_perfectum_anima
- aa_ascendens_anima
- aa_innocens_anima
- mp_perfectum_anima
- mp_ascendens_anima
- mp_innocens_anima

+ some others!

In the future I do want to add more things but I don't have the time to deep dive into modding yet.
